india.one_line: India sees new AI models, partnerships, policy talks, and industrial labs.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot launched Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text system supporting ten Indian languages and Indian English, reporting lower error rates across 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: Tech Mahindra teams with SpaceXSI
themes.text: Tech Mahindra announced a collaboration with AI coding platform SpaceXSI to modernise legacy applications and improve developer productivity for global enterprises.

stories.headline: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI to boost AI‑assisted software engineering

themes.title: BRICS forum to address AI ethics
themes.text: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi will discuss ethical artificial intelligence, human‑centric AI use, and capacity building for lawmakers.

stories.headline: BRICS parliamentary forum in Delhi to discuss AI ethics and global challenges

themes.title: LTM opens industrial AI lab
themes.text: LTM opened the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai, enabling clients and partners to develop, simulate, and validate AI solutions for industrial operations before deployment.

stories.headline: LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
